_doc: Seamless ambience beds (build_ambience.py), all REAL field / room recordings. Each variant is one or more layers; a layer is the steadiest `loop_s` + `xfade_s` stretch of its source (picked automatically: the stretch whose 0.5 s block loudness varies least, no events), high-passed at 20 Hz, made seamless with an equal-power crossfade of its tail into its head (the loop point is the crossfade), then set to the ambience layer's loudness. `pick` = which of the steadiest non-overlapping stretches a variant takes (0 = steadiest). src is relative to C:\tb\audio-src\amb. Sources: TS Sound Savannah GA (server room), ShapingWaves Piping Systems (sewage plant hall), Detunized Distant City + Hzandbits Urban Winds (all Sonniss GDC 2016, royalty free), Ocular The Provence field loops (own library).
